title: I Took the Hotel Ice-Machine Outage Log to Night Audit

parts.text: I went for ice at 12:22 a.m. and the machine on four was dark with a sticky that said use lobby. The lobby machine was also dark. I was thirty-eight, room 412, holding a splint because I needed ice more than a story. The front desk said both were out and maybe tomorrow. I asked for the outage log. They said they do not log ice. I photographed both machines, both stickies, and the rate I paid that included a kitchenette with no freezer. Then I asked night audit, who actually likes paper. At 12:31 night audit found a work order from 4 p.m. marked completed by day shift.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Day shift closed the ticket while both machines are still dead at midnight.

social.video_title: Both ice machines dead and the ticket already completed — Part 1/2
social.description: Splint, two dark machines, a kitchenette without a freezer. Night audit opened paper. Would you have gone to bed?

parts.text: Night audit reopened the ticket and sent a runner to a sister property with a cooler. I iced the splint. Morning added a night of points and a sentence about not closing work orders from the lobby couch. Day shift still exists. Ice exists again. I do not need a kitchenette to have frozen water in a building that sells sleep. The stickies came down. The log stayed up.

social.video_title: A cooler from the sister property beat the sticky — Part 2/2
social.description: Reopened ticket, points, ice on a splint. Was completed a temperature?
